onboarding.IntroduceService1:
To help you get to know yourself better,
I'll send you a letter every day!
onboarding.IntroduceService2:
If you're not sure what to write,
you can read other letters for inspiration.
onboarding.IntroduceService3:
You can earn {reward} by sending letters
and use them to decorate me!
onboarding.IntroduceService4:
Keep sending letters,
and you might even get a reply from me!
onboarding.login:
If you log in,
I can remember the replies you've sent.
